stories.headline: Mistral bags $24 billion valuation as Samsung leads funding for Europe's AI champion
stories.summary: French AI startup Mistral has raised 3 billion euros ($3.5 billion) in a funding round led by Samsung, bringing its post-money valuation to over 21 billion euros. The capital will be used to expand the company's data center infrastructure and acquire more computing capacity. Mistral aims to train larger and faster open-weight AI models to compete with US rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.headline: Why safe banks can produce fragile economies
stories.summary: An analysis of Southeast Asia's financial ecosystem highlights a gap between conservative banking regulations and the funding needs of high-growth startups. Because conventional lenders require collateral and established cash flows, emerging tech companies must rely on alternative financial institutions to fund high-risk innovation.

stories.headline: Exclusive: Legaltech Lexroom seals first two M&A deals four months after $50m Series B
stories.summary: Milan-based legal AI startup Lexroom has completed its first two acquisitions, occurring four months after securing a $50 million Series B funding round. These acquisitions are intended to support the company's ongoing expansion efforts across Europe.

stories.headline: Kuwait's Dawraty secures $2 million seed backed by Qatar Development Bank
stories.summary: Kuwait-based edtech startup Dawraty has secured an investment from Qatar Development Bank as part of a $2 million seed funding round, valuing the company at $10 million. The startup operates a bilingual, AI-powered learning platform focused on healthcare education and professional certification, and plans to use the capital to support its regional expansion.

stories.headline: Am I a fake founder? What it’s like joining a startup as a cofounder a year late
stories.summary: Gabriella Sahlman, co-founder of Swedish private credit firm Fuels Capital, discusses the unique challenges of joining a startup as a co-founder a year after its launch. The article provides advice on navigating equity, integration, and credibility when entering an already established early-stage company.
